summary: Abbott is american global health care and medical device products company, founded in 1888. Type: listed company. About 73,000 employees (Wikidata). Revenue $42.0 billion (2024). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 4 about funding; 6 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.

insights.one_liner: Abbott is a huge US healthcare company (diagnostics, devices, nutrition, medicines) and an IND visa sponsor, with a sales internship in Hoofddorp.

culture.text: A very large company: 153,528 people on LinkedIn, and it says 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
Staff mostly studied business, marketing, pharmacy, chemistry and biology, and work in sales, operations, healthcare services, IT and engineering.
Its one open role here is a sales internship in Hoofddorp.

open.text: Recognised IND visa sponsor through Abbott B.V., Abbott Biologicals B.V. and Abbott Healthcare Products B.V.
Its one open job here does not require Dutch.
Calls itself an equal opportunity employer that encourages diversity in its workforce.

growth.text: Revenue was $41.95 billion in 2024, with net profit of $13.402 billion.
Wikidata counted 73,000 staff in 2015; LinkedIn now shows about 153,500.

worth_knowing.text: Got FDA approval for new interactive features in its CardioMEMS heart failure monitor app.
Listed on the New York Stock Exchange; the CEO is Robert Ford.
